wrong_controls.name: WC7_symmetry_observation_noted
wrong_controls.details: The 3-body formula is fully symmetric in (a, b, c) -- no antisymmetric term.  Unlike the 2-body case (where |a-b| is essential), 3-body M_native depends only on the multiset {a, b, c}.  This is observed structurally, not derived.
